availability_note: Seafloor Cavern is entered by Dive from Route 128 after the Space Center, before Sootopolis; same gate<=68 pool-84 party as the Route 132-134 battles (Landorus and Tapu Fini are reachable legends). No Underwater/Seafloor species used.

strategy_checks.check: Crobat chooses Tailwind or Taunt turn 1
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Tailwind (Fake Out flinched it); T2 Tailwind resolved ('A tailwind started blowing') but Crobat died to Flare Blitz the same turn and only Barraskewda ever moved under it.

strategy_checks.check: Obstagoon attacks after Flame Orb / Obstruct on contact
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Close Combat at Urshifu; OHKOed by a 4x Close Combat before moving. Flame Orb never activated, Obstruct never seen.

strategy_checks.check: Sharpedo Speed Boost earned per turn
strategy_checks.evidence: Entered T1 end, T2 Liquidation into Urshifu for 202 and a Def drop; died to Close Combat before the first end-of-turn boost could matter.
No Rage Powder was on the field; Barraskewda used Liquidation into Urshifu's Protect, Sash absorbed Knock Off, Sucker Punch finished it.

protect_ledger.entry: No opponent Protect/Obstruct used (Obstagoon, Sharpedo, Barraskewda carry one). No empty Protects.

theme_note: The 'boarding party' reads as Aqua pirates - Sharpedo and Barraskewda are on-brand and no rain is faked - but at these levels the crew is over in three turns with zero player faints, so the cavern mouth does not feel like a climax yet.

level_changes.why: 0-faint win in 3 turns. Obstagoon (L82) is the lowest-levelled member and died to one hit before its Flame Orb turn; it is the bruiser the concept is named after.
The Tailwind setter fell to a single neutral Flare Blitz on the turn its Tailwind went up. Sharpedo/Barraskewda untouched.

level_changes_unverified: Cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds the headless ROM; attempt 1 was played at offsets 0/1/1/1.
cooler: The faction identity is right (fast, mean, no weather crutch). What it lacks is a survivable turn: every member folds to one Fighting hit and the Tailwind never buys anything. Levels are the right first lever; if that is not enough, a Sitrus or Lum on Obstagoon instead of the Flame Orb (not this pass) would give the boarding party a second turn.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all four sets played as written.
